S.D.N.Y. · No. 1:24‑cr‑00542‑AS United States v. Combs Sean Combs, the music producer known as Diddy, was tried in federal court in New York in 2025. The jury cleared him of racketeering conspiracy and sex trafficking, and found him guilty on two counts of transporting people for prostitution. He was sentenced to 50 months in prison and has appealed. Indicted Sept 12, 2024 Before Subramanian, J. Verdict Jul 2, 2025 Status On appeal
